units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63a">Snh. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיוּוּ אלוהות וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:10">Ab. Zar. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>לאלוהות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) they had a desire for many deities. Denom. <cite ref="V00015"><he>תַּאֲוָה</he></cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="A00939"><he>אוּת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (b. h.), Nithpa. נִתְאַוֶּה (denom. of תַּאֲוָה) to desire, to be seized with a desire.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (play on <he>י̇ת̇א̇ד̇ם̇</he> <cite ref="Proverbs 23:31">Prov. XXIII, 31</cite>) the drunken man <he>וכ׳ לד̇ם̇ יִ֗תְ֗אַ֗וֶּה</he> will covet blood (forbidden intercourse).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:3">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>התחילו מִתְאַוִּים וכ׳</he> they began to express a desire for standards (in imitation of the angelic hosts).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:3">Ib.</cite> divide them into standards <he>כמו שנִתְאַוּוּ</he> as they desired.
